description: This file defines the 'RecipeListAdapter' class, which implements the Android 'ListAdapter' interface to provide data and views for a list of recipes in a wearable app. It loads JSON data representing recipes, parses it into items with titles, names, summaries, and images, and provides view rendering logic for list items.

classes.name: RecipeListAdapter
classes.description: A custom adapter class implementing 'ListAdapter' to provide recipe data and views for a list in an Android wearable app.

methods.name: loadRecipeList
methods.description: Loads the recipe JSON data from assets and parses it into item objects.

methods.name: parseJson
methods.description: Parses a JSONObject containing a list of recipes into a list of Item objects with title, name, summary, and image.

methods.name: appendItemsToList
methods.description: Adds parsed items to the internal list and notifies the observer about data change.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of recipe items available.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns the recipe item at a specified position.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns a stable ID for the item, here always 0.

methods.name: getItemViewType
methods.description: Returns the type of view for the item, here uniform (0).

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Creates or recycles a view for a list item, setting title, summary, and image.

methods.name: getViewTypeCount
methods.description: Returns the number of different view types, here 1.

methods.name: hasStableIds
methods.description: Indicates whether item IDs are stable; returns false.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the recipe list is empty.

methods.name: registerDataSetObserver
methods.description: Registers a data set observer for data change notifications.

methods.name: areAllItemsEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether all list items are enabled; here true.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether a particular item is enabled; here true.

methods.name: getItemName
methods.description: Returns the name of the recipe item at the specified position.
